text:
alex_cs: Heads up — Oceanic Systems (acct oce-879) just pinged about a $15k contract credit that sales added via PO note but never showed up on their billing dashboard. They provisioned usage yesterday and invoice came back full. Can billing take a quick look?
elaine_sales: yep that PO note was added on the contract: PO# 450219 — note text: 'Apply promo Q3-2025-ENT-15K'. I confirmed with the AE. They expected an immediate applied credit.
alex_cs: I pulled the audit logs and see the contract update, but our billing job didn't create the credit entry. Error in billing audit: 
```
error: invalid_billing_mapping: no promo tag matched for PO note 'Apply promo Q3-2025-ENT-15K'
context: contract_id=ctr-4499, sales_note="Apply promo Q3-2025-ENT-15K"
```
elaine_sales: ugh — Sales has used a few fmt variants, we thought the parser picks them up. We tried tagging with 'promo:' previously but AE used the freeform text.
ravi_billing: can you paste the invoice id? I want to see if the credit creation failed or if the credit was created but not linked. Also tagging @sara_engineer because sounds like PO-note parser again.
alex_cs: Invoice ID: INV-2026-07-3145. Full audit trace lines:
```
[2026-04-02T14:13:08Z] job=billing-run v=2.8.1 started
[2026-04-02T14:13:12Z] mapping.lookup -> nil for contract ctr-4499
[2026-04-02T14:13:12Z] error invalid_billing_mapping: key not found
```
alex_cs: Customer is hitting our support SLA, asked for a manual credit while this is fixed.
elaine_sales: Can we do a manual grant for $15,000 and add a PO note mapping on our end? They need the applied credit this billing cycle.
ravi_billing: We can apply a manual adjustment but need approval + proper memo for ledger. I'll prepare the GL entry if someone confirms amount and reason. Also need to run the internal admin API.
elaine_sales: Confirmed: $15,000 contract-level credit, reason: Sales promo Q3-2025 applied per PO 450219. Approver: Elaine Li.
sara_engineer: I'll look at the PO-note parser. Quick glance — we're only matching notes with regex containing 'promo_code:' or 'PROMO-' prefix. Freeform 'Apply promo Q3-2025-ENT-15K' won't match. I can push a small patch to relax matching to look for 'promo' + digits/words, but that needs a quick test and deploy.
ravi_billing: For the manual credit, here's the admin CLI I will use (internal):
```
POST /internal/billing/adjustments
{
  "contract_id": "ctr-4499",
  "amount_usd": -15000.00,
  "type": "manual_contract_credit",
  "reason": "Sales PO 450219 - Q3-2025 promo",
  "metadata": {"invoice_id":"INV-2026-07-3145","sales_rep":"elaine_sales"}
}
```
ops_bot: deploy queued: billing/patch-po-parser v2026.4.2 -> canary starting in 5m :rocket:
sara_engineer: I'll hold on the relaxed parser deploy until Ravi confirms manual grant done, so we don't double-apply. Plan: manual grant now, then parser deploy to auto-handle future similar notes.
ravi_billing: Manual adjustment submitted by finance; journal ID JL-77821 created. Applied to invoice INV-2026-07-3145 as a negative line item. Confirmed balance now reflects $15,000 credit.
elaine_sales: :tada: Thanks Ravi. I told Oceanic it'll be reflected; they asked if there's anything they need to do on their end — told them no.
alex_cs: Noted — I'll close the support ticket once customer confirms on their end. Sara, keep me posted on the parser PR and rollout.
sara_engineer: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infer/commit/abc123 — relaxes PO-note matching to /promo[\s_\-]?(code|\w*)/i and adds unit tests. Canary started by ops_bot.
ops_bot: canary deploy succeeded for billing/patch-po-parser v2026.4.2-canary :white_check_mark:
sara_engineer: Patch merged to main; scheduled full deploy in 30m. I'll monitor logs for any false positives.
alex_cs: Customer confirmed: credit shows up now, invoice updated, they verified UI and chargeback. Closing external ticket. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
